name: HIS Billing Module
description: Handles all patient billing, charge capture, itemized bill generation, correction requests, financial waivers, refund processing, and audit trail management.

name: HIS Insurance Module
description: Manages patient insurance policy verification, coverage checks, pre-authorization tracking, cashless treatment authorization, and insurance claim status monitoring.

name: HIS Clinical Module
description: Core clinical documentation system covering admissions, physician orders, nursing notes, discharge summaries, consent forms, and patient care plans.

name: HIS Radiology Module
description: Manages radiology study scheduling, report generation and tracking, DICOM image storage linkage, and turnaround time monitoring.

name: TPA Submission Portal
description: External web portal for submitting pre-authorization requests, uploading insurance claim packages, monitoring claim status, and receiving TPA adjudication decisions.

name: Computerized Maintenance Management System
description: Tracks all facility and biomedical equipment maintenance, PM work orders, repair requests, spare parts inventory, and vendor service contracts. Produces the Monthly Equipment Reliability Report.

name: Pharmacy Management System
description: Manages prescription dispensing, drug inventory and stock levels, controlled substance register, medication reconciliation workflows, and pharmacy stock-out alerts.

name: Laboratory Information System (LIS)
description: Manages lab test orders, specimen tracking, result entry and verification, critical value alerting, specimen rejection notices, and turnaround time reporting.
